title: von Platen Coaching: a calm one-page site for a coaching practice
excerpt: The website for Anna-Maria von Platen's coaching practice. One page in German and English that explains her view of stress, shows how she works and what it costs, and ends in a contact form that reaches her inbox.
challenge: Anna-Maria von Platen coaches the self-employed and people in caring professions on stress. Her practice needed a first web presence that sounds like her: calm, concrete and free of wellness clichés. A visitor should understand her approach, see the three steps of working with her and the prices, and be able to ask for the free 15-minute intro call without friction.
solution: webvise designed and built vonplaten-coaching.de as a single page with twelve sections, from the opening statement through topics, method, prices and FAQ to the contact form. The look is dark eucalyptus green with mint, a grotesk for reading and an italic serif for the words that carry her voice. Fine contour lines and a stress scale are the only illustrations. The site is German first with an English version a visitor can switch to, the contact form sends through Resend, and the page runs on Next.js and Vercel.

signature.title: A site that sounds like her
signature.body: A coaching practice is chosen for the person. So the page carries her own sentences in an italic serif, set against a calm grotesk on dark eucalyptus green. A stress scale shows where her work begins. The lines and the scale are drawn in code.

results: One page with twelve sections, from the opening statement to the contact form
German first, with an English version a visitor can switch to
The three steps of working together and the prices stated on the page
Four topics she helps with, each in her own words
A contact form for the free 15-minute intro call that reaches her inbox
A stress scale and fine contour lines as the only illustrations
